name: bsweep
shell: claude mcp add --scope user bsweep -- sudo -n /home/alex.guest/agent-mcp/bsweep mcp --allow-changes
note: Changes need root, so the assistant starts bsweep with sudo -n, which never asks for a password and fails if one is needed. Let alex run bsweep without a password: sudo visudo -f /etc/sudoers.d/bsweep, and add the line: alex ALL=(root) NOPASSWD: /home/alex.guest/agent-mcp/bsweep
